action_requested: Create GLM-5.2 Red-Team Critic service scaffold

context.goal: Create a red-team critic microservice scaffold at services/redteam-critic/ that accepts an evidence pack (JSON) and routes it to GLM-5.2 via the local OmniRoute proxy (http://localhost:20128/api/chat) for adversarial critique. The service must: (1) expose a POST /critique endpoint accepting {evidence_pack, context} JSON, (2) format the prompt as a red-team adversarial review instruction, (3) call OmniRoute with model='glm-5.2' in a try/catch with graceful fallback if OmniRoute is offline (return a 'deferred' status), (4) return {verdict, risks, recommendations, confidence}. Create app/main.py (FastAPI), app/routers/critique.py, app/core/prompt_builder.py, app/models/schemas.py (Pydantic), and requirements.txt. NO external API calls during scaffold — OmniRoute URL must be configurable via env var REDTEAM_OMNIROUTE_URL with localhost default. All calls must be read-only (POST to local proxy only).
constraints: no external API calls — local OmniRoute proxy only
no package install — scaffold files only
deliverables: FastAPI service structure with critique endpoint
Prompt builder for adversarial red-team review
requirements.txt with fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, pydantic
